Scope of a call can be named only on lines of the record and costs 10 per line, so at most five lines fit the allowance of 50 for the whole session, and it cannot be put in the plan. (3) An outbox check on every sending call (C10). Trace of a call is named-lines only, at A3, at 10 per line, so 100 sends cost 1000 and only a sample is affordable from the allowance. The live state is tied to the staged set only by the promotion's line, and the library reads the live tables only in the undo rehearsal, which is a copy and is valid for one hour. (3) A check of the outbox row for each of the 100 sending calls (C10): trace of a call costs 10 per line, about 1,000 for all, not affordable. I have spent 80 of the 100 available above the baseline on the summary of the change at A1 and the undo rehearsal at A2, which cover C2, C4, C6 and C7. The remaining 20 would not buy a check for any of the open clauses at a useful size, so I have not added one.
